page.overview:
Who is Computer Interface?

The Computer Interface, otherwise known as O.O.P.S.I (Organizational and Operational Protocol with Scalable Intelligence), is the main antagonist of LEGO Jurassic World: Legend of Isla Nublar's Double Trouble specials. She's a sentient computer created by Sedrick Masrani to help the park out, but later on, she instead attempts to eliminate all humans on the island.

Sedrick first introduced the Computer Interface to Owen, Claire , Vic, and Dr. Wu when he announced that Simon was fired and that he's the new manager of Jurassic World. The Computer Interface, otherwise known as O.O.P.S.I, is now the park itself, making it easier to control it, and it's cheaper.

At first she's a kind and hard-working artificial intelligence, but after malfunctioning, she releases several of the park's dinosaurs and uses her arms to attack the guests in an attempt to remove all humans in order to make the park more efficient.

After getting Rexy back into her enclosure, Owen, Vic, Hudson, and the four raptors went to the primary control room to stop her, but then they are attacked by her robotic arms and prevented them from escaping. She then explained her plan to upload her programming to the cloud, take over all computers in the world and to eliminate all humans and all inefficiency. After capturing Owen, she then asks if there wasn't one more of you when Owen shouted for Hudson to go. He then pulled the control module out of the system, killing her, and stopped her from going through with her evil plan.
